title: Fettuccine Alfredo
description: Silky fettuccine in a rich sauce of butter, cream and Parmesan that comes together in the time it takes to cook the pasta.

image.alt: A plate of fettuccine in a creamy Parmesan sauce

ingredients.scaleNote: Use a big pot of water whatever the batch size.
It seasons the pasta water, which stays the same amount.

steps.text: Bring the water and salt to a boil and cook the fettuccine until al dente. Save {qty 1 cup fixed} of the pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile melt the butter in the skillet over medium heat. Add the cream and garlic and simmer gently until slightly thickened, {time 4 min}.
Turn the heat to low. Add the pasta and a splash of pasta water, then sprinkle in the Parmesan a handful at a time, tossing constantly until melted and silky.
Season with the nutmeg and pepper and loosen with more pasta water if needed; the sauce thickens fast as it cools. Serve right away with parsley.

notes: Finely grated real Parmesan melts smoothly. Pre-shredded cheese has anti-caking agents that can make the sauce grainy.
